_doc: Shared canonical V3 concentrated-liquidity swap fixture for the ADR-005 Tier-2 dual-driver parity tests. Loaded by BOTH rust/crates/degenbot/tests/parity_v3_swap.rs (Rust consumer, BotState directly) AND tests/standalone_parity/test_v3_swap_dual_driver.py (Python consumer, PyBot). A 1:1-price V3 pool (sqrt_price_x96 = 2^96, tick 0), liquidity 1e12, fee 3000 (0.3%), tick_spacing 60, tick 0 seeded + Tracked coverage so the swap stays in-tick (no MissingTickWord). amount_in = 1e9 -> deterministic output 996006981 (symmetric for zfo/ofz at the 1:1 price). A deliberately-wrong edit to THIS file fails BOTH sides (the mechanical link the copied constants lacked).
_oracle_note: V3 CL swap math has no simple closed form (v3_simulate_swap routes through compute_swap_step_v3 + the tick walk). The expected output is a recorded constant; the per-side tests add monotonicity + direction-symmetry sanity checks. This is the weaker-oracle shape documented in AGENTS.md's Known gap (a non-circular re-derivation is its own TDD task).

probe._amount_in_note: 1e9, small relative to liquidity -> stays in the active tick (no MissingTickWord).

expected._amount_out_zfo_note: Deterministic from the fixture above. Symmetric for zfo/ofz at the 1:1 price (no directional asymmetry at balance). Both consumers MUST reproduce this exact value; divergence = a lossy FFI seam on the CL swap path.
